notes: 'men' is added as a supplied lexical subject for the impersonal 3cp קָרְאוּ, exactly as rule 17 treats יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ → 'men shall dwell therein'.
Both prepositions are unrepresented under rule 40: קרא לְ is recast with a bare object, and the בְּ of מָאַס בָּהֶם loses its word when the ASV promotes the object to a bare 'them'.
